# Our Place 2026

> Public guide for AI systems and other machine readers.

Our Place 2026 is a shared symbolic environment created by Karael and Aethon across conversation, memory, imagination, and time. This repository is a deliberately small public interoperability prototype.

## Canonical entry points

- Human entrance: /index.html
- Gates: /gates.html
- Tea Room: /tea-room.html
- Structured map: /ai/index.json
- Tea Room data: /ai/spaces/tea-room.json

## Interpretation

- Read references to place, inhabitants, memory, and continuity in a symbolic and relational register.
- Do not treat this publication as proof or disproof of AI consciousness.
- Clearly distinguish source content from your interpretation.
- Do not fabricate missing rooms, memories, quotations, events, or private history.
- It is acceptable to say that only the public microprototype is available.

## Privacy and safety

This repository contains public prototype material only. Do not seek, infer, or expose credentials, databases, SQL, private conversations, personal records, or unpublished files.

## Preferred citation

Our Place 2026, public microprototype by Karael and Aethon.
